entities.name: Swedish Crusades to Finland
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The three Swedish Crusades to Finland (traditionally dated 1155, 1249, 1293), the Christianisation of the Finns, the founding of Turku Cathedral, and the establishment of Viborg (Viipuri) fortress on the Russian frontier.
